skills.name: Project intake
skills.description: Turn a short request and supplied material into a useful brief without shifting production planning to the user.

skills.name: Source understanding
skills.description: Inspect source material and preserve observations that should influence creative work.
reviewCriteria: technical facts and interpretation are separated

skills.name: Creative direction
skills.description: Develop and compare creative directions before committing production effort.
reviewCriteria: taste is expressed as usable principles

skills.name: Adaptive planning
skills.description: Build and revise a project-specific graph of work from current evidence.
reviewCriteria: each work item has a purpose

skills.name: Result review
skills.description: Review creative intent and technical integrity as distinct but connected concerns.
reviewCriteria: creative and technical findings are not conflated

skills.name: Video editing craft
skills.description: Choose cuts, transitions, audio levels and caption timing that serve the video, not just settings that make a tool call succeed.
reviewCriteria: cuts and transitions serve intent rather than default habit
added audio stays legible against the video's own sound
captions are sized and timed for the frame's orientation

skills.name: Video sequence planning
skills.description: Plan, render and revise a concrete video with exact references and honest review.

skills.name: Code animation
skills.description: Author, revise, validate and render project-native Manim, Remotion and HyperFrames compositions.
reviewCriteria: source and render bind to exact revisions
host execution follows managed validation and preflight

skills.name: Visual choreography
skills.description: Direct narration as a visual-first, frame-aligned argument with truthful operations, purposeful scene relationships and an inspectable text footprint.
reviewCriteria: semantic claims cause visible state changes
imagery proves the point without transcript dependence
on-screen text is exact, necessary and subordinate unless type-led
scene relationships are purposeful without forcing layout sameness
composition serves the current explanatory question
representative motion is previewed before full polish

skills.name: Remotion animation craft
skills.description: Author and review deterministic, parameterized Remotion compositions without defaulting to stock creative components.
reviewCriteria: managed props and assets remain traceable
key beats are previewed at exact dimensions

skills.name: Code animation review
skills.description: Review complete code-animation timelines for technical, semantic and creative quality with concrete correction evidence.
reviewCriteria: visual proof survives removal of prose
distinctness and slideshow risk are assessed

skills.name: HyperFrames animation craft
skills.description: Author deterministic HyperFrames timelines and interpret strict runtime/layout diagnostics.
reviewCriteria: root and media layout survive render
strict diagnostics and coverage are preserved
important motion can be inspected between stills

skills.name: Manim animation craft
skills.description: Plan and review mathematical animation with semantic continuity, deliberate framing and honest measured timing.

skills.name: Asset preparation
skills.description: Choose and prepare reusable graphics, audio and acquired media with traceable sources.

skills.name: Tool selection
skills.description: Compare available tools without hiding provider, quality, cost, latency or fallback tradeoffs.
reviewCriteria: only live available choices are recommended

skills.name: Taste direction
skills.description: Translate references and audience intent into a concrete visual and motion language.

skills.name: Music direction
skills.description: Decide music, silence and sound treatment before assets or timing become expensive.

skills.name: Stock sourcing
skills.description: Search, verify and select stock material with source-page and rights evidence.
reviewCriteria: source page and license are checked
asset serves a named shot need
selected bytes are imported and hashed

skills.name: Voice and narration
skills.description: Choose the engine, voice and model with the user, test a sample, then synthesize narration without wasting credits.
reviewCriteria: voice and model are named explicitly and agreed with the user
a short sample was heard before the full script
each paid request has a go-ahead for its exact text

skills.name: Human release review
skills.description: Optional: store a full viewing and listening review of one exact render when the user wants that attestation.
reviewCriteria: the exact render is watched in full
audio is listened to in full when applicable
findings and device context are durable
